pages.text: The tray slides out to its left. Keep that side, the front and the top clear.

$(li)a Life Support Jar$(li)Relay Goggles$(li)a Collar Cam$(li)4 Cranial Saline$(li)40 kFE, from a pile or Leyden Jar touching it$(br2)Load them in its panel; sneak and use the chair to open it without sitting.
pages.title: Form 27-B

pages.text: Use it to sit; hold Sign for 2 s. It takes 12 s; in the first 5 you may get up, keeping the parts, losing 10 kFE.$(br2)Your head goes on the tray (or an empty Cradle within 3 blocks). To carry it, use it with a Head Satchel in your inventory.
Range 48 blocks; Mk II 160, Mk III 640. Use new ones on your placed or docked head.
Bolted to your neck: your body sees through it.
